notes: synthetic elements: thin=0.8px medium=2.4px thick=4.8px; declared 1px=0.8px; dpr=1.0000000149011612

Consequence for the backlog item: converting the six surviving `thin` border widths in composer/Composer.module.css and permissions/PermissionCards.module.css to var(--oc-border-hairline) is a ZERO-PIXEL change in this engine — the two compute identically here. It is a consistency change, not a visual one.

Scope: this says what THIS Chromium does, measured here, on this display. The CSS spec fixes only the thin<medium<thick ordering and leaves the widths UA-defined, so this is an engine measurement, not a standards claim, and it is an observation outside this run's acceptance criteria.
